The '''Kor Trinivii system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the ''[[Bootana Hutta/Legends|Bootana Hutta]]'' region of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. It was part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] section of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It was connected by a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] to the [[Kor Gejalli system/Legends|Kor Gejalli system]].<ref name="TEA" />

The Kor Trinivii system contained the [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Kor Trinivii]], the [[Throneworld/Legends|throneworld]] of the [[Trinivii]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]].<ref name="TEA Kor Trinivii" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Kor Trinivii system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square S-11.<ref name="TEA" />
